visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontaler Slider mit Bild- oder Video-Karten, Titel und Text
visualCharacteristics.layout: ~3 cards visible on desktop, ~2.2 on tablet, 1.25 on mobile; scroll-snap
visualCharacteristics.media: image or looping muted video (plays while visible)
visualCharacteristics.controls: round prev/next buttons bottom-right, keyboard arrows on focused track

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image (with alt, optional); cell 2: video link (MP4 in DAM, optional, replaces image); cell 3: title (h3) + text

reuseGuidance: Use for feature sliders with more items than fit in a row; for a static grid use a cards variant.
